Regulator Circuit The regulator consists of voltage regulator Q1, power pass transistor Q3 and Q3's driver transistor Q2. The regulator accurately regulates the logic power input to the game PCB by monitoring the voltage through high-impedance inputs +SENSE and SENSE. The inputs are directly from the +5 VDC and ground inputs to the game PCB. Therefore, the regulator regulates the voltage on the game PCB.
